item.oneLineDescription: Keep every git commit message in the type(scope): description format.

manifest.ruleMarkdown:
# Conventional Commits

Every git commit message follows the conventional format.

- Subject: `type(scope): description` — types are feat, fix, refactor, chore, docs, style, test, perf, ci.
- Scope is optional but encouraged: `feat(auth): add oauth login`.
- Description is lowercase, no period at the end, subject line under 72 characters.
- Add a body for complex changes explaining WHY, not WHAT.
- One logical change per commit — never bundle unrelated work.
